raw.description: 战斗开始时，为己方添加白幕，若自身的1号位技能名中存在颜色，则将己方的幕染为对应的颜色|自身登场时，若对方没有任何颜色的幕，则为对方添加白幕|任意一方幕的颜色改变时，当回合结束后位于场内的自身恢复最大体力的1/3与所有技能1点PP值|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]战斗开始时，为[color=#52a5f2]己方[/color]添加[color=#f35555]白幕[/color]，若自身的[color=#57c975]1号位技能[/color]名中存在颜色，则将[color=#57c975]己方[/color]的[color=#f35555]幕[/color]染为对应的颜色；自身[color=#57c975]登场时[/color]，若对方没有任何颜色的[color=#f35555]幕[/color]，则为对方添加[color=#f35555]白幕[/color]|[sprite name=dot4]任意一方[color=#f35555]幕[/color]的颜色[color=#57c975]改变[/color]时，[color=#52a5f2]当回合结束后(329)[/color]位于场内的自身恢复最大体力的1/3与所有技能1点PP值

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 四项最新回答补足同回合变色次数、初始时序与白幕归属、唯一最高抗性加20个百分点及黄幕保留暴击归零红伤；当前双方首次附效不延期。
review.singleBehavior: 先全部建染和补白，再首次附效；白幕当前HP1%真伤归幕拥有者且涂蝶魂印来源，红幕唯一最高抗性+20个百分点，蓝砥砺1回合，黄2回合保留暴击归零红；实际变色回末仅回复一次三分一与全PP1。

success.name: 4861真实2046按实际1号位建白幕并染黄蓝赤，无颜色仍白；敌无幕补白，初始附效在建染完成后结算
success.assertion: test('4861真实2046按实际1号位建白幕并染黄蓝赤，无颜色仍白；敌无幕补白，初始附效在建染完成后结算',()=>{for(const [move,color]of[[38226,4],[38227,3],[38228,2],[38236,1]]){const s=make({soul:true,move});assert.equal(s.curtains2046.sides[0],color);assert.equal(s.curtains2046.sides[1],1);assert.deepEqual(s.curtains2046.history[0],color===1?[1]:[1,color]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,color===1?8910:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,8910);assert.equal(s.curtains2046.pendingInitial,false);}});

success.name: 4861真实2046稳定在场单次变色回合结束后回复最大HP三分一与全PP1，技能禁疗不阻魂印，同色不回复，多变色当回合只回复一次
success.assertion: test('4861真实2046稳定在场单次变色回合结束后回复最大HP三分一与全PP1，技能禁疗不阻魂印，同色不回复，多变色当回合只回复一次',()=>{const s=stable({move:38225,index:3,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38225)],1);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves.filter(k=>k!==key(38225)))assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],Math.min(2,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp));s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);const multi=stable({move:38225,index:3,hp:1000});multi.curtains2046.changes.push({round:1,side:0,from:1,to:2});turn(multi);assert.equal(multi.fighters[0].hp,4000);});

success.name: 4861已答初入场：白幕建染先于双方附效，白真伤归拥有者且来源魂印，蓝幕砥砺与黄幕两回合当前生效
success.assertion: for(const [move,color]of[[38236,1],[38228,2],[38227,3],[38226,4]]){const s=make({soul:true,move,index:-1});assert.deepEqual(s.curtains2046.sides,[color,1]);assert.equal(s.curtains2046.pendingInitial,false);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,color===1?8910:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,8910);const events=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='true');assert.equal(events.length,color===1?2:1);for(const e of events){assert.equal(e.sourceSide,e.targetSide);assert.equal(e.settledDamage,90);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,90);}if(color===3)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['砥砺'],1);if(color===4)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['黄幕抵挡致命'].end,2);}

success.name: 4861已答多变色：己敌双方反复改变当回合只回三分一和全PP1，同色不授，死亡不回复，技能禁疗不阻魂印
success.assertion:
for(const count of[0,1,2,5]){const s=make({soul:true,move:38236,index:-1,hp:1000});s.curtains2046.changes=[];timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){for(let n=0;n<count;n++)c.curtainAbilities2046().change(c,n%2,n%2===0?2:3);if(count===5){c.curtainAbilities2046().change(c,0,4);c.curtainAbilities2046().change(c,0,2);}}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,count?4000:1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38236)],count?1:0);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves.filter(k=>k!==key(38236)))assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],count?Math.min(2,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp):1);}
 const dead=make({soul:true,move:38226,index:-1,hp:1,bStats:{atk:9999}});dead.fighters[0].effects={};turn(dead,38226,10127);assert.equal(dead.fighters[0].hp,0);

success.name: 4861已答红幕：唯一最高异常抗性加20个百分点，无抗性或并列最高不授；实际施异常采用提升后概率
success.assertion: const original=E.createBattle;for(const values of[{'中毒':.55,'烧伤':.18},{'中毒':.18,'烧伤':.18},{},{'中毒':.8,'烧伤':.18}]){E.createBattle=options=>{options.builds[0].resistance={slots:[{name:'中毒',chance:Math.round((values['中毒']??0)*100)},{name:'烧伤',chance:Math.round((values['烧伤']??0)*100)},{name:'',chance:0}]};return original(options);};try{const s=make({soul:true,move:38228,index:-1});const unique=values['中毒']>0&&values['中毒']>values['烧伤'];assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.curtainResistance2046?.status,unique?'中毒':undefined);assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance(s.fighters[0],'中毒'),Math.min(1,(values['中毒']??0)+(unique?.2:0)));const seen=[];if(values['中毒']===.8)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(let i=0;i<100;i++){delete c.t.ailments['中毒'];c.t.resistUntil=0;seen.push(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2));}},()=>turn(s));if(values['中毒']===.8){assert.ok(seen.every(x=>!x));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2,'红幕提升至全抗时不消费次数免异');}else{assert.ok(seen.some(Boolean));if(Object.keys(values).length)assert.ok(seen.includes(false));if(values['中毒']===.55)assert.ok(seen.filter(Boolean).length<40);else if(!Object.keys(values).length)assert.ok(seen.every(Boolean));}}finally{E.createBattle=original;}}

success.name: 4861已答黄幕：保留暴击判定和命中暴击后效果，前两回合只将暴击红伤归零，普通红伤与附加固伤不归零，第三回合到期
success.assertion: for(const critical of[false,true]){const s=make({soul:true,move:38226,index:-1,criticals:critical});s.curtains2046.changes=[];s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].operations=[];let hits=0,crits=0;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeCrit'&&c.a.side===1)c.forceCrit=critical;if(e==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===1){hits++;c.hurt(c.t,100,'命中固定','fixed');}if(e==='beforeIncomingAttack'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.crit,critical);if(c.crit)crits++;}},()=>{for(let r=1;r<=3;r++){turn(s,38226,10127);assert.equal(sum(s)>0,false);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),100);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1)===0,critical&&r<=2);}});assert.equal(hits,3);assert.equal(crits,critical?3:0);}

success.assertion: test('4861/585六能力逐项提升、5特防20%成功失败，911有正阶段双强；164反睡眠与48免异47免弱191反弹',()=>{const s=make(row(585));turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],1);const seen=new Set();for(let i=1;i<=32;i++){const a=make({...row(5),seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(a);seen.add(a.fighters[1].stages.spd);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[-1,0]);for(const n of[0,1]){const a=make(row(911));a.fighters[0].stages.def=n;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,n?2:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,n?3:1);}const react=make(row(164));turn(react,25255,10127);assert.ok(react.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']);for(const id of[48,47,191]){const a=make(row(id));turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(id===47){c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}else{assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(!!c.a.ailments['中毒'],id===191);}}},()=>turn(a));}});

success.assertion: test('4861/585六能力逐项提升、5特防20%成功失败，911有正阶段双强；164反睡眠与48免异47免弱191反弹',()=>{const s=make(row(585));turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],1);const seen=new Set();for(let i=1;i<=32;i++){const a=make({...row(5),seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(a);seen.add(a.fighters[1].stages.spd);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[-1,0]);for(const n of[0,1]){const a=make(row(911));a.fighters[0].stages.def=n;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,n?2:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,n?3:1);}const react=make(row(164));turn(react,25255,10127);assert.ok(react.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']);for(const id of[48,47,191]){const a=make(row(id));turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(id===47){c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}else{assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(!!c.a.ailments['中毒'],id===191);}}},()=>turn(a));}});

success.assertion: test('4861/1443连续威力100%逐次增加封顶400%且间断重置；1619真实对手已用招才能复制，失败回复半血全弱',()=>{const s=make(row(1443));for(const expected of[100,200,300,400,500,500]){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,expected);}turn(s,38237);s.fighters[1].hp=9000;let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.power,100);const none=make({...row(1619),hp:1000});turn(none);assert.equal(none.fighters[0].soulState.nativeCopy16194658.reason,'no-released-target');const seen=new Set();for(let i=1;i<=24;i++){const a=make({...row(1619),hp:1000,aStats:{spe:1},seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(a);const st=a.fighters[0].soulState.nativeCopy16194658;seen.add(st.reason);if(st.reason==='failed'){assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,5500);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages[k],k==='atk'?0:-1);}if(st.reason==='copied')assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,1);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),['copied','failed']);});

success.name: 4861/450与683与118三次独立随机抽样范围0至255，真实回血固定伤害与威力各自变化，禁疗不取消其余抽样

success.assertion: test('4861/585六能力逐项提升、5特防20%成功失败，911有正阶段双强；164反睡眠与48免异47免弱191反弹',()=>{const s=make(row(585));turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],1);const seen=new Set();for(let i=1;i<=32;i++){const a=make({...row(5),seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(a);seen.add(a.fighters[1].stages.spd);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[-1,0]);for(const n of[0,1]){const a=make(row(911));a.fighters[0].stages.def=n;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,n?2:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,n?3:1);}const react=make(row(164));turn(react,25255,10127);assert.ok(react.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']);for(const id of[48,47,191]){const a=make(row(id));turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(id===47){c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}else{assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(!!c.a.ailments['中毒'],id===191);}}},()=>turn(a));}});

success.assertion: test('4861/1036成功清回合授下两次固定300且保护失败不授；29固定50与2073每种异常红增50%',()=>{for(const protectedCase of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1036));timer(s,1,'priority');if(protectedCase)timer(s,1,'protect');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackFixed??0,protectedCase?0:2);if(!protectedCase){s.moveDefinitions[key(38227)].operations=[];for(const n of[300,300,0]){turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),n);}}}const fixed=make(row(29));turn(fixed);assert.equal(sum(fixed,'fixed'),50);for(const n of[0,1,2]){const s=make(row(2073));if(n)s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']=3;if(n===2)s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;let c;observe((e,x)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&x.a.side===0)c=x;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(c.modifier,1+n*.5);}});

success.assertion: test('4861/585六能力逐项提升、5特防20%成功失败，911有正阶段双强；164反睡眠与48免异47免弱191反弹',()=>{const s=make(row(585));turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],1);const seen=new Set();for(let i=1;i<=32;i++){const a=make({...row(5),seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(a);seen.add(a.fighters[1].stages.spd);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[-1,0]);for(const n of[0,1]){const a=make(row(911));a.fighters[0].stages.def=n;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.atk,n?2:1);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,n?3:1);}const react=make(row(164));turn(react,25255,10127);assert.ok(react.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠']);for(const id of[48,47,191]){const a=make(row(id));turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(id===47){c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,0);}else{assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2),false);assert.equal(!!c.a.ailments['中毒'],id===191);}}},()=>turn(a));}});
